global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with tender chashu pork and a crisp nori sheet. Served in a white bowl with floral trim, it rests on a dark wooden table under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with floral pattern and black rim, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved shape.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows rich, golden-brown liquid swirling around thin, white noodles and green onions, with a glossy, oily sheen.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip, showing subtle glaze texture.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, triangular, with visible surface wrinkles and a slightly curled edge.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with a pale, tender-looking interior and slightly browned, glistening surface.
